title: The Big Dipper
info: The Big Dipper is a bright group of seven stars. It looks like a pot with a handle.
It is part of the bigger constellation Ursa Major, the Great Bear. A small pattern like this is called an asterism.
Two stars in the bowl point toward Polaris, the North Star.
